column1: # Persian (Farsi) interface catalogue. english<TAB>translation; a line left
# out, or left empty, falls through to the English.
# Written right to left and joined, like Arabic. Noto Sans Arabic ships with
# Deckboy and draws it on every machine, beside the desk's own face for Latin,
# so there is no #font line; the shaper lays each label out with the Unicode
# bidi algorithm, so a Latin word or a number inside it keeps its own
# Words use the half-space (U+200C, ZWNJ) where Persian writes one --
# پاک‌کردن, تمام‌صفحه, می‌شود -- and the shaper keeps it inside the word it
# belongs to. Clock-face counts use Persian digits (۱۲ ساعته); ports, ids,
# formats and other values an operator types stay in the digits they type.
# NOT YET REVIEWED BY A PERSIAN SPEAKER: written without one, so the picker
# says so. Corrections are very welcome.
